title: Portfolio metric overrides
description: Manual overrides for synced git metrics. Written by hand; only `drift keep` / `drift keep-all` touch this file, and only to refresh an existing entry's baseline. Each field carries the pinned value alongside the synced baseline at the time the override was set, so the drift report can flag when the ground truth has moved.

overrides.description: Keyed by project slug (matches ProjectSlug in types.ts).

SlugOverrides.description: Per-field overrides for one project. Keys mirror the OVERRIDABLE_FIELDS allow-list enforced in src/lib/data/data.test.ts: every ProjectMetrics key except commitsHeadlineScope, plus commitAnyLast and commitAnyRoot.

_note.description: Why this project has manual overrides.

commitsHeadline.description: The role-keyed display figure: all-authors count for solo projects, Jason-scoped for team projects. Pin this to override what's shown regardless of role.

linesAny.description: Total lines across tracked source files, all authors.

linesAnyAdded.description: Lines added by all authors, lifetime.

linesAnyRemoved.description: Lines removed by all authors, lifetime.

linesMeAddedRecent.description: Lines added by Jason, trailing 4 weeks.

linesMeRemovedRecent.description: Lines removed by Jason, trailing 4 weeks.

linesAnyAddedRecent.description: Lines added by all authors, trailing 4 weeks.

linesAnyRemovedRecent.description: Lines removed by all authors, trailing 4 weeks.

commitAnyLast.description: ISO date of the most recent commit.

commitAnyRoot.description: ISO date of the root commit (project inception).

NumericOverride.description: Override for a field that has a synced source. syncedWhenSet records the synced value when the override was authored; the drift report flags when current synced !== syncedWhenSet.

syncedWhenSet.description: The synced value at the time this override was set. Null means a pure pin with no baseline: the drift report never flags it as stale.

syncedField.description: The underlying synced field to compare against (defaults to this field's name). Only `commitsHeadline` ever needs this — set to 'commitsMe' for team projects, 'commitsAny' for solo.

_setNote.description: Why this value was pinned (context for future-you).

DateOverride.description: Override for a date field (commitAnyLast, commitAnyRoot). syncedWhenSet records the synced date string when the override was authored.

syncedWhenSet.description: The synced date at the time this override was set.

_setNote.description: Why this date was pinned (context for future-you).
